output.title: Code-owner review — APPROVED
output.summary:
Independent cold-context code-owner re-verification of PR #175 (feat/agent-ui-driver into main).

Verdict: APPROVED. Verified directly from the diff (not via the /code-review skill):

- Driver/recorder/loader (UIDriverTests, UIWalkthroughRecorder, UIActionScript): generic, data-driven, fail-soft as documented. Correct.
- Accessibility identifiers: purely additive .accessibilityIdentifier(...); ForEach -> Array(...enumerated()) keeps id: \.element.id, so SwiftUI identity and visible behavior are unchanged.
- project.yml/scheme: HanahuacUITests target added and wired into the test action; iOS Simulator scope honored.
- origin/main integration (merge ed84224): AppLocale enum has 14 cases 1:1 with 14 on-disk *.lproj/Localizable.strings (ca de en es-ES es-MX eu fr it ko nah nl pl sr yua). Bot-review migration + CODEOWNERS removal are the expected migration content.
- CI on head ed84224 is green: Build & Test, gitleaks, Lint (all languages) all success.

The 3 independent-review nits (grep||true masking covered by the artifact-existence check; dead SUPPORTS_MACCATALYST:YES on the UI-test target; resolveElement label-first precedence) are genuinely non-blocking and confirmed non-blocking on my own read.

All acceptance criteria are reachable at a real runtime call path: the just ui-walkthrough recipe drives the production app and the identifiers live in production views. Posting success clears the required code-owner-review gate.
